title: Junior Engineer (JEN/JE)
qualification: Applicants must also possess working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture, as prescribed in the recruitment rules. || Qualification Note: The revised recruitment covers six departments governed by different service rules. Applicants must verify the exact accepted Engineering qualification for the selected post and department in the official notification.
salary: Selected Junior Engineers will receive pay according to Rajasthan Pay Matrix Level 10 , subject to the applicable departmental rules. || During the prescribed probation period, candidates will receive fixed remuneration according to Rajasthan Government rules. Regular pay and allowances become applicable under the conditions governing successful completion of probation.
age_limit: The general age requirement is 18 to 40 years as on 1 January 2027 , before applicable age relaxation.
application_fee: RSSB follows Rajasthan's One-Time Registration (OTR) fee system. Candidates who have already paid their applicable OTR registration fee do not need to pay the same fee again. || Candidates belonging to reserved categories who are permanent residents of other states or Union Territories will generally be treated as General category candidates for this recruitment, according to the notification's reservation and fee provisions.
selection_process: The selection process consists of the recruitment examination and subsequent eligibility and document verification stages. || Online application submission. || Junior Engineer recruitment written examination. || Preparation of merit and shortlisting according to the applicable rules. || Document and qualification verification. || Department allotment on a merit-cum-priority basis. || Final selection and appointment under the relevant departmental rules.
